title: Extract Blue Screw rectangle pointers and targets
changes: Extend the observed tilemap resource with seven pointer cells and five distinct 1x12 rectangles, retaining alias bindings, source gaps and guest reads outside the represented spans.
validation: Source e204-rectangle-source-t31eyd12 authenticates 158 bytes and two pointer aliases. Wine e205-rect-readers-wine-pf3lqjl7 verifies preservation, coherent-edit rejection, mirrors, mixed-owner boundaries, ten original-interpreter/native indexed reads, five width-reader prefixes and one 12-halfword DMA with equal state and guest clock.

Wine e205-rect-scene-wine-qfr83rk5 matches state, guest clock, video, OAM, dispatch and audio for 600 Blue Screw frames with all 158 backing bytes altered; the first pointer and rectangle are used. Wine e205-rect-cli-wine-c3n9eh_b creates, reuses and verifies 124 files matching the tested dataset. All Wine servers drained without the D-Bus assertion using the local backport.
limitations: Other selectors, ordinary use of the remaining rectangles, consumers, real BIOS, lifecycle and older revision-pinned fixtures remain open. Linux, USA and native Windows remain pending; no performance measurements.
